subject: Adapting CIO slot for Redwood demo — sponsor handshake & quick cadence
messages:
From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@argosystems.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Correa <nadia.correa@argosystems.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — CIO availability question

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — our team loved the latency/throughput numbers. We have the CIO (Mark Leland) tentatively held for Tuesday 12/05 at 10:30am PT but his calendar is tight and he may need to swap to 11:15am or move to Wednesday morning.

Two asks:
- Can we compress the exec portion to 20 minutes focused on high-level outcomes and prescriptive next steps?
- If Mark moves, can you confirm who would act as the executive sponsor from Redwood for that slot (VP/Director level backup)?

I attached our updated priorities and a tentative agenda. If it helps, Nadia is on standby to take notes and handle the follow-ups.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: argos-priorities.pdf (link stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@argosystems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — CIO availability question

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the priorities doc. Happy to compress the executive portion to a focused 20-minute CIO briefing: 5m context, 10m outcomes + customer impact, 5m next steps. That should fit cleanly.

For sponsor coverage: Karthik can cover as VP-level sponsor and handle the business outcomes piece if Mark needs to move to 11:15 or Wed AM. Priya will join for security/compliance Q&A.

Can you confirm which alternate Mark prefers (11:15am Tue or Wed 9:00–10:00am PT)? If you push to 11:15 we’ll keep the same run-of-show with a tighter Q&A. If Mark picks Wed, Karthik can still take the slot but we may expand to 30 minutes to include a one-slide quant of expected savings.

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda draft)

Date: Sat, 02 Dec 2028 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — CIO availability question

Looping in now — thanks for the invite, Irene. I can cover as VP sponsor for any of the alternate slots. Quick notes:
- If it's 11:15 Tue, we should keep the deck to 6 slides and drop the deep-dive timing; Priya, please have the security one-pager ready to send during Q&A.
- If Wed morning works better for Mark and the Argo exec team, let's extend 20->30 minutes and include a 3-minute ROI slide tailored to Argo's S3-to-GPU inference cost case.

Irene — can you put a tentative calendar hold for both alternates (Tue 11:15am PT, Wed 9:15am PT) and mark them as tentative? Alex/Nadia, please reply with preferred. I can join live or dial in; if Mark prefers a shorter slot we’ll prioritize the executive narrative.

Karthik

Appreciate the flexibility.
